text_block_list.text:
Around noon, while picking out dessert at 
the buffet section—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Aha, Trainer-kun! What sits before you is 
the 'Super Sweet Banana Cake'...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, that's not it. Ugh, so they 
really are out of stock...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, didn't you know? It's the ultimate 
classic among the Academy's desserts!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Bananas contain anti-inflammatory 
nutrients and are great for injury 
prevention. That makes them an essential 
snack to eat before training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the super sweet banana cake 
tastes utterly flawless!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The harmony of whipped cream and rich 
banana is sheer perfection! And the way it 
melts the moment it touches your 
tongue...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem*! But if it's out of stock, it 
cannot be helped. I shall look for an 
alternative dessert.
